title: RFL Per-skill ε-tolerance table
description: The Class 2-loose conformance tolerances (spec/02 RD2c, spec/05): for each contact-dynamics primitive (every force.* + in_hand.pivot passive drive), the per-quantity tolerance ε its realized execution is held to under a named metric. Values are `null` until measured (the data-dependent pre-freeze item); the structure is fixed now so a conformant runner can read it. Anti-drift invariant C9 (schemas/validate.py) checks the key set is exactly the contact-dynamics primitive set derived from skill-isa.

epsilon_tolerances.description: Keyed by Skill ISA primitive id (a contact-dynamics primitive). Each value is a map of measured-quantity name to its tolerance entry.

additionalProperties.description: The per-quantity tolerances for one primitive.

ToleranceEntry.description: One measured quantity's tolerance: the comparison metric and the bound (null = not yet measured).

metric.description: How realized vs canonical are compared for this quantity. geodesic_se3 / geodesic_so3 for poses/orientations (m + rad / rad), l2_norm for vector quantities (e.g. wrench), abs for scalars.

tolerance.description: The ε bound in the quantity's units, or null until measured. A null tolerance means the loose check is not yet gradeable for this quantity (never silently a pass).

unit.description: Optional unit hint for the tolerance (e.g. "m", "rad", "N", "N*m").
